title: AutumnOS release metadata, schema 1
description: Exact existing 13-field T03 release contract. Duplicate keys and unknown fields rejected. Shared ReleaseManifestValidator performs cross-field checks.

channel.description: preview exactly when application version has SemVer prerelease identifiers; GitHub prerelease must agree.

runtime.description: Only web is install-compatible in this host. Native EXE payloads remain rejected.

entry.description: Release entry rejects any consecutive dots, matching ReleaseManifestValidator.

asset.description: Exactly one asset of the selected release, never its source ZIP. Tag must be version or v+version.

saveFormatVersion.description: Must equal package manifest saveFormatVersion (default 1 for old packages). Readable range is validated from the package manifest before commit.
